title: ME41606: Finite Element Methods In Engineering
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequsites: ME10602, 20604Introduction-Basic Concept of FEM, Methods of
weighted residual techniques-Weak Formulation, Galerkin FE formulation,
Rayleigh and Ritz FEM,FEM analysis of One-dimensional problems:-Second order
boundary value problem, Applications in Solid, Fluid and Heat Transfer, Bending
of Beams, Euler-Bernoulli Beam, Truss/Frame analysis, Eigenvalue and Time
dependent problems, MATLAB Application, Numerical Integration and Computer
Implementation-Natural Co-ordinates, Interpolation Functions, Numerical
Integration, Isoparametric Formulation, Computer Implementation, Applications
in two-dimensional problems-Plane Stress and plane Strain, Three Dimensional
Solid, Axi-symmetric Solid, Plate and Shell structures, Flow of Viscous Fluid,
MATLAB Application, Special Topics, Stationary Singular elements, Quarter-Point
Singular Elements, Moving singular elements, Semi-infinite elements, Buckling
analysis, Non-linear analysis
